motions.what: transform scaleX of the Highlighter block behind the promise word, 0 to 1, from the left

motions.trigger: A section crosses 15 percent into view, once
motions.what: opacity 0 to 1 and translateY 8 px to 0

motions.trigger: Hover, focus or tap on a plate
motions.what: Other plates dim to 55 percent; the plate's label fades in

motions.trigger: The CTA band crosses 30 percent into view, once
motions.what: The robot rises: translateY 40 percent to 0

motions.trigger: The hero has been in view and idle for 8 s
motions.what: The robot's eyes: scaleY 1 to 0.1 and back
motions.loop: At most 3 per visit, at least 8 s apart

motions.trigger: A control opens the contact modal or the menu sheet
motions.what: Backdrop opacity 0 to 0.45; panel opacity and translateY 8 px (modal) or 100 percent (sheet) to 0

motions.trigger: Close, Escape, or a click outside
Hover or focus on a link
A photo band scrolls through the viewport
motions.what: The photo's transform translateY from minus to plus the parallax distance, tied to scroll, not time

motions.trigger: Scrolling down 8 px past twice the bar's height
motions.what: The bar translateY 0 to minus 100 percent; the wordmark button rises from below the screen and fades in

motions.trigger: A scroll up of 12 px or more, or the top of the page
motions.what: The reverse of bar-fold: the whole bar slides back in; the button sinks away

motions.trigger: Hover (after 60 ms), focus or a click on the wordmark button
motions.what: The menu's opacity 0 to 1, translateY 8 px and scale 0.98 to rest, from the button's corner; it closes 240 ms after the pointer leaves

motions.trigger: The form finishes sending or finds an error
